text: 中文字幕 Dear students, welcome to my class.This is the sixth period of Unit 2.Today we will read a passage, friends reunited.By the end of this period, you are expected to1.Understand the story and figure out its key elements and features.Acquire some words and expressions related to the topic and sort out a topic-centered network.Retell the story, reflect on the moral lesson and share it.Please make sure you've got your textbook and worksheet ready.Now, take a look at the pictures on page 30.What animal is it in the picture?Well, it's a penguin.Where does it live?Maybe in the sea?Or in the aquarium?Who is the man?How old is he?Would you take a guess?What do you think the relationship between the man and the penguin is?What might have happened?I believe you have your own versions.What does the word reunited mean?Can you tell me?The word reunite means to bring two or more people together again after they have been separated for a long time, or to come together again.In Chinese, it means 重逢,再次相聚。Now, read the first paragraph quickly and complete Activity 1 on page 31.Read the questions.Complete each answer by using a relative clause.What is the relationship between the man and the penguin?whel, let's check the answers.Ding Ding is a penguin, who was found lying on the rocks and closed to death on the beach.誰是丁丁?丁丁是一隻蜜蜂他被發現在河邊在河邊附近死去蜜蜂死了他很可憐誰是朱敖?他如何照顧丁丁呢?朱敖是一隻復活蜜蜂他把蜜蜂的油沾在蜜蜂的肚子裡把蜜蜂吃了一天的蜜蜂然後把蜜蜂穿上褲子把蜜蜂叫丁丁因此,朱敖每天給蜜蜂吃了蜜蜂讓蜜蜂再次變得體力強壯現在,我們知道丁丁和朱敖是故事中的角色很明顯,他們之後就變成朋友了那他們發生了什麼事呢?他們如何變成朋友呢?我們來讀一下2-6的文章當你讀完,請考慮他們如何變成朋友有些問題可以幫助你請不吝點贊訂閱轉發打賞支持明鏡與點點欄目請不吝點贊訂閱轉發打賞支持明鏡與點點欄目請不吝點贊訂閱轉發打賞支持明鏡與點點欄目請不吝點贊訂閱轉發打賞支持明鏡與點點欄目What did Yu-wul do after Dingding recovered?We can get the answer from Paragraph 2 AC Advertising listYu-wul tried to release Dingding after Notory was removedand he refused他试图把丁丁放下,后他恢复了。什么是恢复的呢?您可以猜测一下吗?若尔试图把蝙蝠从他的地方出发,在那里被捕的地方。我将为您提供一个例子,以便您有更好的理解。恢复了,鸟儿完全康复了,现在可以让它们重返大自然了。第二个问题,丁丁在岸上恢复后,做了什么?在词中也能找到,蝙蝠在周尔的背面。丁丁回到周尔的家,最后丁丁和周尔相处了11个月。丁丁把衣服换成新衣服后,他离开了。丁丁消失后,他回来了吗?从那开始,他经常去见老人。那么,他经常去见老人?他经常去见老人吗?根据文章,丁丁每个夏天都会去见老人。是否很常见一只鸟去见老人?在夏天,普通的蝙蝠会做什么?有些人知道,蝙蝠经常移到餐厅。你去哪里找到这些信息?所以,丁丁经常都会去见老人。他在哪里找到这些信息?丁丁经常去见老人?他经常去见老人?于是,丁丁经常都会去见老人。所以,丁丁经常会去见老人?而不是更多的资金。What does the word migrate mean?If a bird migrates,it moves from one part of the world to anotheraccording to the season.In Chinese, 迁徙。Therefore, people believethat Dingding returns to the little beachto visit Jiao every summer,while his species,the wild animals,migrate to their feeding areas.I'd like to show you one more example.Most birds have to flylong distances to migrate.绝大多数鸟类为了迁徙都不得不进行长距离的飞行。Can you guess why Dingdingprefers the elderly man?Clearly, he wants toreunite with his friendsinstead of moving to other placeswith its species.What do you think of Dingding's choice?It's not a conventional choice.Question 4What do Jiao and Dingdinglike to do when they are together?From this part,it is clear thatthey sometimes take a walk togetherdown the beach.No one else is allowedto go to the beach.No one else is allowedto touch him.We can infer that only Jiaotouches Dingding.Also, Jiao gives him showers.Jiao bathes the penguin.He feeds him sardinesand picks him up.The elderly mancheats Dingdingjust as any parentcheats his little child.Dingding does not allow othersto feed him or touch him.So, their relationshipis special.Actually, we can saythey have an attachmentto each other.Attachment means一恋.How can we describe their attachment?Can you findsome other details which showtheir strong attachment to each other?In paragraph 4,Jiao recallshow the penguincontinued to follow him home.Can you feelhow proud Jiao is?We can findwhat Jiao says alsoin paragraph 4.Now, pleaseread what Jiao saysand guess how he feels.You may discusswith your deskmate.You can discuss with your deskmate.Jiao recallshow the penguincontinued to follow him home.Can you feelhow proudhe is?We can findwhat Jiao says alsoin paragraph 4,Jiao recallsWell, time is up.I'd like to share my understanding of the sentences.Sentence 1.Everyone said he wouldn't return, but he has been coming back to visit me for the past four years.We can learn that Dingding does not disappoint John, and has been visiting him in the past four years.I believe John must have felt happy, proud and pleased.He arrives in June and leaves to go home in February, and every year he comes more affectionate as he appears even happier to see me.If you are affectionate, you show caring feelings and love for someone.In Chinese, 表示关爱的。John can feel what Dingding feels.They have become founder of each other, and their relationship becomes stronger and closer.After finishing reading the story, we know how John and Dingding became friends.They trust each other.They are devoted and loyal to each other.In Unit 2 of Book 1, you've learned how the story usually develops.The key elements include when, where, who, what, how and why.Below is an outline of the story you've just read.Complete the diagram with information from the text, and check your comprehension.You will have two minutes.Well, let's check.What's the setting of the story?The story started in 2011, in a seaside village in Brazil.Who are the characters?Joao, a retired bricklayer, and Dingding, a South American penguin.What's the plot of the story?Can you identify the events?The beginning, development and end.In the beginning, Joao found a penguin, close to death, on the beach.What happened then?Joao took great care of Dingding, and the penguin recovered fully.Joao tried to release Dingding, but he came back to Joao's home.When Dingding changed his coat for new feathers, he disappeared.Dingding has been visiting Joao for the past four years.What's the ending of the story?Joao and Dingding have become close friends.What message does the story send us?Well, there is much food for thought.Personally, I think human beings and animals can build a harmonious relationship.After finishing the diagram, I think you have a better understanding of the story.The last paragraph ends with the question, who said there wasn't still some good news left in the world?It's a rhetorical question.The answer is yes.It's obvious that there is some good news left in the world.The story offers food for thought.Now it's time for group work.Discuss with your group members.What moral lessons can you learn from the story?You may have two minutes.Thank you for watching.
